subject: general
question: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan will improve the socio-economic condition of tribal communities, covering around _____ villages as per Union Budget 2024-25.
solution:
The correct answer is __**63,000**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Union Budget 2024-25, the **Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan** aims to improve the socio-economic condition of tribal communities and will cover around 63**,000 villages**.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan (PMJUGA) **is an initiative launched by the Government of India **aimed at bringing socio-economic **development to tribal communities residing in rural areas**.
 
• The scheme will adopt saturation coverage for tribal families in tribal-majority villages and aspirational districts.
 
• The **Ministry of Tribal Affairs will act as the nodal ministr**y for the overall monitoring and implementation of the scheme.
 
• It has** various objectives, features which can have a far reaching impact towards the goal of tribal empowerment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objectives of Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan (PMJUGA)**

 
 
• **Integrated Development:** To ensure holistic development of tribal villages by addressing infrastructure gaps and improving basic amenities.
 
• **Livelihood Opportunities**: Enhancing livelihood opportunities for tribal communities through skill development, employment generation, and promoting traditional livelihoods.
 
• **Health and Education**: Improving access to healthcare facilities and promoting education among tribal populations.
 
• **Cultural Preservation:** Preservation and promotion of tribal culture, traditions, and heritage
